**What did you run?** (the command, with any secrets removed)

**What happened?** (paste the output; check it contains no token, secret or personal data)

**What did you expect?**

**Setup:** OS, Python version (`python3 --version`), how you installed (plugin / pipx / by hand), `li-auth check` output.

> Never paste a client secret, access token, authorization code or `.env` file. If you did by mistake, rotate it now and edit this issue.
